Locate or Open the DesiredGainR Breeder's Guide

Source: R/breeder_guide.R
open_desiredgain_guide.Rd

The PDF and HTML editions of the DesiredGainR Breeder's Guide are standalone companions to the Defining a breeding objective vignette. They cover the same material in plain language: what a breeding objective is, why economic weights are difficult to state, how to read a feasibility result, how to choose among the index families, and how to judge whether a recommendation is robust. No R code is required to read the guide.

Usage

open_desiredgain_guide(open = TRUE, format = c("html", "pdf"))

Arguments

open

Logical, default TRUE. When TRUE and the session is interactive, the file is opened with the operating system's default application through browseURL. When FALSE, or in a non-interactive session, only the path is returned.

format

Character, one of "html" (default) or "pdf". HTML is the default because it needs only pandoc, whereas the PDF edition also requires a LaTeX installation and is therefore the more likely of the two to be absent.

Value

The file path, invisibly, to the selected edition in the installed package. An explicit error is raised when the requested edition is unavailable, rather than a silent fallback to the other format.

Details

It is intended for breeders, programme managers and reviewers who will use or approve a selection decision but do not necessarily run R themselves.

The PDF provides a fixed-layout reference edition and the HTML edition renders the same content for on-screen reading. These standalone files have no vignette engine, so they are not indexed by vignette()/browseVignettes() like the package's .Rmd vignettes. Their version-controlled source is inst/guide/DesiredGainR_Breeder_Guide.Rmd; both generated files ship in inst/extdata/ and are located via system.file.

See also

The Defining a breeding objective vignette (vignette("DesiredGainR-objective", package = "DesiredGainR")) for the same material with full statistical detail and runnable code; gain_feasibility, implied_economic_weights, weight_sensitivity.

Examples

# Locate without opening, which is what a script should do.
path <- try(open_desiredgain_guide(open = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
#> [open_desiredgain_guide] Guide located at: C:/Users/fakohoue/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.5/DesiredGainR/extdata/DesiredGainR_Breeder_Guide.html
if (!inherits(path, "try-error")) file.exists(path)
#> [1] TRUE
